def pumpCaER(cCai, cCao, Vm, T, p):
    """
    Pumps calcium out of the cell and into the endoplasmic reticulum.
    Vm is the voltage across the endoplasmic reticulum membrane.

    """
    deltaGATP_o = p.deltaGATP
    cATP = p.cATP
    cADP = p.cADP
    cPi = p.cPi
    Qnumo = cADP * cPi * cCai
    Qdenomo = cATP * cCao
    inds_Z = (Qdenomo == 0.0).nonzero()
    Qdenomo[inds_Z] = 1e-16
    Q = Qnumo / Qdenomo
    Keq = np.exp(-deltaGATP_o / (p.R * T) - 2 * (p.F * Vm / (p.R * T)))
    numo_E = cCao / p.KmCa_Ca * (cATP / p.KmCa_ATP)
    denomo_E = (1 + cCao / p.KmCa_Ca) * (1 + cATP / p.KmCa_ATP)
    frwd = numo_E / denomo_E
    numo_Eb = cCai / p.KmCa_Ca
    denomo_Eb = 1 + cCai / p.KmCa_Ca
    bkwrd = numo_Eb / denomo_Eb
    f_Ca = p.serca_max * frwd * (1 - Q / Keq)
    return f_Ca

def electroflux(cA, cB, Dc, d, zc, vBA, T, p, rho=1):
    """
    Electro-diffusion between two connected volumes. Note for cell work, 'b' is
    'inside', 'a' is outside, with a positive flux moving from a to b. The
    voltage is defined as Vb - Va (Vba), which is equivalent to Vmem.

    This function defaults to regular diffusion if Vba == 0.0.

    This function takes numpy matrix values as input. All inputs must be
    matrices of the same shape.

    This is the Goldman Flux/Current Equation (not to be confused with the
    Goldman Equation). Note: the Nernst-Planck equation has been trialed in
    place of this, and it does not reproduce proper reversal potentials.

    Parameters
    ----------
    cA          concentration in region A [mol/m3] (out)
    cB          concentration in region B [mol/m3] (in)
    Dc          Diffusion constant of c  [m2/s]
    d           Distance between region A and region B [m]
    zc          valence of ionic species c
    vBA         voltage difference between region B (in) and A (out) = Vmem
    p           an instance of the Parameters class

    Returns
    --------
    flux        Chemical flux magnitude between region A and B [mol/s]

    """
    FLOAT_NONCE = 1e-25
    vBA += FLOAT_NONCE
    zc += FLOAT_NONCE
    alpha = zc * vBA * p.F / (p.R * T)
    exp_alpha = np.exp(-alpha)
    deno = -np.expm1(-alpha)
    flux = -(Dc * alpha / d) * ((cB - cA * exp_alpha) / deno) * rho
    return flux

scope_limits: Conditional supplied-state ER update correspondence, not native initialization/restart/full Simulator or whole-conservative-tissue parity. Neutral countercharge is a declared manufactured initial inventory with original0.2mM calcium.
Thirteen neutral declarations include controls and contexts; two sign probes and repeated numerical resolutions do not constitute new biological cases.

Three2ms outer calls cover6ms. Diagnostic histories also use1ms/.5ms over the same6ms with original forcing changes at2ms/4ms. Complete matched-time differences were recomputed, but no accuracy threshold or convergence-order claim is awarded.

Small local error fractions do not establish independent accuracy of the upstream ordinary material/CaATP prefix or long-term voltage feedback. Maintained fuel pools remain explicit; no finite-fuel, GPU or whole-cell biological claim.
No numerical test, reference, native source, model integration or active-job query was executed for this review. Only saved arrays, hashes, identities and error ratios were checked.

def __init__(self, sim, cells, p):
    self.er_vol = 0.1 * cells.cell_vol
    self.er_sa = 1.0 * cells.cell_sa
    self.Ver = np.zeros(sim.cdl)
    self.Q = np.zeros(sim.cdl)
    self.cm_er = p.cm
    sim.cc_er = copy.deepcopy(sim.cc_cells)
    sim.cc_er[sim.iCa][:] = 0.2
    self.Dm_er = copy.deepcopy(sim.cc_cells)
    for arr in self.Dm_er:
        arr[:] = 1e-18
    self.Dm_er_base = copy.deepcopy(self.Dm_er)
    self.Dm_channels = copy.deepcopy(self.Dm_er)
    self.zer = copy.deepcopy(sim.cc_cells)
    for i, arr in enumerate(self.zer):
        arr[:] = sim.zs[i]

def update(self, sim, cells, p):
    self.channels(sim, cells, p)
    f_CaATP = stb.pumpCaER(sim.cc_er[sim.iCa], sim.cc_cells[sim.iCa], self.Ver, sim.T, p)
    sim.cc_cells[sim.iCa] = sim.cc_cells[sim.iCa] - f_CaATP * (self.er_sa / cells.cell_vol) * p.dt
    sim.cc_er[sim.iCa] = sim.cc_er[sim.iCa] + f_CaATP * (self.er_sa / self.er_vol) * p.dt
    for i in sim.movingIons:
        IdCM = np.ones(sim.cdl)
        f_ED = stb.electroflux(sim.cc_cells[i], sim.cc_er[i], self.Dm_er[i], p.tm * IdCM, sim.zs[i] * IdCM, self.Ver, sim.T, p, rho=1)
        sim.cc_cells[i] = sim.cc_cells[i] - f_ED * (self.er_sa / cells.cell_vol) * p.dt
        sim.cc_er[i] = sim.cc_er[i] + f_ED * (self.er_sa / self.er_vol) * p.dt
    self.get_v(sim, p)
